capabilities: render a note as a printable 2.5x3.5 inch poker card
open a card preview window via a command
customize card type, title and CSS classes through frontmatter properties
extras: The README states the plugin is very much in-development and invites contributions via contact or GitHub issues.
problem: Obsidian cannot render a note as a fixed-size printable card, so making physical cards from notes requires manual layout elsewhere.
summary: Note-to-card renderer that displays notes as printable 2.5x3.5 inch poker-sized cards with customizable titles and styling.
